title: Total Let Down
text: I did not know about these funko boxes until I saw a venom box online which I thought was a decent box.  I went online and watched all the previous unboxings when funko sent them out and man what a difference between the content of the boxes.  I saw the first 10 years and had to give it a shot and what a let down.  A movie moment w/ whiplash? Really? There are so many options to choose from and they chose whiplash?  Then two pint size figure which shows a total lack of creativity and a pez.  Only 4 items total out of 7 possible items.  I would maybe spend $10 for this total if I were to see the contents prior to buying.  Since this is my first box I am going to give the X-men box a shot and the X-men are my favorite comic book heroes so I am stuck on the next one.  I can see me canceling after the X-men box because I sense it will be a let down.  They can always get me back with a punisher or captain america box.  It also took too long to get the box; one full week after the order date.
label: negative
